name: io.github.D-Asce/pandastocksdk
title: pandaData A-share Market Data MCP Server
description: Realtime A-share (Chinese stock market) data via NATS request/response: stock quotes, market indices, concept/industry sectors, K-line history (daily/minute), financial news, limit-up/down statistics, Dragon-Tiger list, capital flow, bull/bear comparison and DDX data. 22 request/response interfaces open to the public test account; 176 total interfaces documented.
